messages:
maria: Heads-up — HarvestAI signed LOI for Dedicated in eu-west. They committed 1200 GPU-hours/month but legal wants a buffer policy written before SOW.
aj: 1200 GPU-hours — is that A100-80GB equiv or smaller instances?
maria: They asked for "high-throughput" 80GB equivalents. Our mapping assumes A100-80GB equiv. If we apply a simple buffer math, 1200 + 30% = 1560h.
samir: 30% feels high for baseline. For new accounts we usually target 20-25%. HarvestAI has periodic crawler spikes and a daily batch, so I lean 25%.
leo: Quick conversion to GPUs: 1 A100-equivalent GPU = 24*30 = 720h/month.
leo: 1560 / 720 = 2.17 -> round up to 3 GPUs reserved to hit SLOs.
maria: Note: they want eu-west pinning. We can route overflow to eu-central but that adds egress + higher latency — product may not accept it for synchronous features.
finance-ella: Cost check requested. Provide roughs and I'll model margin.
ops-bot: plan-update: customer=HarvestAI commit_hours=1200 proposed_buffer_pct=25 proposed_total_hours=1500 (auto-generated).
aj: Another commercial lever: split into base commitment + burstable credits billed at premium. Lowers upfront commitment for customer while preserving our tail protection.
maria: Proposed commercial structure (draft): base 1000h reserved (2 GPUs), burst pool 500h at 1.6x unit price, buffer 15% applied to base only. Effective available hours ~1500.
samir: That helps reduce over-provisioning risk. On infra side we need: pin 2 GPUs in eu-west, allow burst to eu-central, and a local fallback to quantized variants if the burst limit is hit.
leo: Example rollout/policy snippet for ops config:
```
commit_policy:
  base_commit_hours: 1000
  burst_pool_hours: 500
  burst_multiplier: 1.6
  buffer_pct_on_base: 15
  fallback_variant: quantized-13b
  preferred_region: eu-west-1
  overflow_region: eu-central-1
```
maria: I will draft the SOW/pricing and include the routing/overflow notes. Need finance numbers + legal clause for cross-region fallback. @finance-ella please confirm final price cadence, @aj please take SLA wording.
finance-ella: Basic numbers: base rate estimate = $3.20/hr per A100-equiv (reserved), burst billing = base * 1.6 = $5.12/hr. So base 1000h -> $3.2k, burst 500h -> $2.56k. Monthly invoiced ~$5.76k pre-tax. Margin looks fine after infra ops.
aj: Sounds reasonable. I'll add canary rollback and a clause: "fallback to quantized variant if end-to-end p95 latency > 800ms for 5m".
samir: Ops action items: (1) Reserve 2 GPUs in eu-west cluster, (2) create burst pool in eu-central, (3) implement rate-limiter that enforces burst_multiplier and bills at higher unit rate, (4) add alert for cross-region egress > XGB.
maria: I'll cc legal and put the draft in the HarvestAI deal checklist.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: commit-policy/harvestai branch -> staging at 2026-11-12T09:00:00Z.
finance-ella: One more ask — include a monthly usage report with token-level cost breakdown so HarvestAI can see burst utilization. They asked for transparency.
leo: We can export per-route metrics and a CSV for the billing page.
maria: Great. If no objections I'll finalize and send to sales+legal today. :thumbsup:
aj: LGTM.
finance-ella: Approved from finance.
maria: Thanks all — will update thread with SOW link once drafted.
